[b]Cól System[/b].
A yellow star, target of colonization , it showed a large civilization in past, that colonized it entirely, or at least tried , and had it main planet extinct , to what is today believe to be caused by a asteroid , and the "numans" as they call themselves , blue humanoids, that after the impact, were forced to colonize the rest of their planetary system in order to not die.
We arrived there in 2245.
Cól: a yellow dwarf star, that , reports showed the star seems too unstable , and indeed it is, the core has a slight alteration, that makes it gravity little stronger, making the first planet be tidal locked while it solar eruptions being stronger than usual ones in other systems,  radiation rays can travel too far in space reaching even the 4th planet(Mars), avoid traveling any closer to it always.
Dangerous flares and winds alongside radiation make it dangerous for any inner planet , it premature instability reason is unknown however, is theorized tthat at some time of their history, numanity tried capture their star energy in order to use it for their own, but this failed and caused the star instability which last until today.
[b]Mérkut[/b]: the first planet,  unhabitable, is tidal locked due Cól strong gravity over it, while also suffering from destructive winds from it star, while it side to the star is impossible to land, the "dark side"is more possible for us, and the Chimú made outposts extracting silicate and aluminum from it surface.
[b]Fànus[/b]: second planet of the system , very hot, with a thick atmosphere, but not as much as it was in past, solar winds and flares wiped out many of it dense atmosphere, still, the planet has been slowing down and is expected to be completely tidal locked until next 2 millennia, the planet has a terrifying surface which rains acid and crushing pressure, lack of any valuable resource and even less climate , make it not too attractive for either colonizing or making mines, however on it clouds, there are satellites, called "Bèran-1, Bèran-2...until Bèran-9, all are administrated by cyborgs, 3 per sattelite , Bèran-8 and Bèran-9 functions are to check out and analyze the situation of Fànus, and effects of it star "attacks" on the plantes, the other 7 are tasked to analyze and possible revert the Cól instability .
Sensors analyze the star's core, spectrometers detect flares and  CMEs, or anything ejected by Cól , the inner has a central enormous computer, alongside other rooms for operation of the sattelite, laboratories and a special room for the robots fill up with energy.
Other two sattelites designated to focus on Fànus  with systems directly connected to it core and surface, analyzing everything, some systems , in the central computer called "support", include a gigantic shield to protect the sattelites against the Star attacks, as the thick clouds of Fànus protect the planet from radiation as well as the sattelites.
[b]Sùpacamác[/b]: Hellish Camác, or hellish Erene, the best description indeed, once home of Numans, humans with longer ears and blue skin, also 4 fingers rather 5.
The planet is abandoned, with many old sattelites colliding it, the moon , called Làwá show older colonization marks, Sùpacamác has many old destroyed cities, dried oceans , all registries found of Numan history was taken and put in a single sattelite, called the "Khitába", historical depot, copies of it were sent to the interplanetary libraries in Chanchán at Erene and New Chanchán at Pùnapà.
Limited life forms living in extreme conditions were found, Pompei worms archæas, and other lifeform .
Many sattelites are in the planet orbit or skies, some are trying to reduce the numbers of CO2 in the atmosphere, which are enormous and introduce more oxygen, while trying to create clouds , but the most challenging is , a new magnetic field, some bases are trying interact with the planet core in order to restore  it magnetic field which most were weakened, until that time, we live in cities in domes.
[b] Mác[/b]:the planet colonized by numans, and their main planet, numans have no interesting talent or physical aspect to be used for, in fact, we trade with them, selling them oxygen and water , in exchange they give us their resources such as potassium , and mainly, deuterium, due it essential properties on nuclear fusion, which could also help us possibly fix Cól.
Many Chimú mines can be found, as we have interest on extraction of chemicals the planet has , in fact, very valuable chemicals can be found and are used , and as well large depots of iron.
Numans have a total population of 2 million people in there, while our colonies have a total of 100k people living.
[b]Wánìmedy[/b]:a large sattelites with enormous depots of water, our reports detected a large population of 3.4 million numans living here under domain of a man called "Elon Musk", his true appearance is unknown, he is believe to be dead a long time, but in cryogenic state while his mind connected to a computer enslaving all his population.
[b]Ewùrobá:[/b] with enormous depots of ice sheet under it surface, Ewùrobá is also ruled by "Elon Musk", similar to Wánìmedy, it people live mining ice to sell water to other colonies, life was detected under it ice sheets, research outposts detected small life forms similar to squids living in the deep ice of the sattelite.
[b]Kpàllît[/b]: a moon  that accepted alliance with Chimor, they are our allies , in exchange we protect them from"Musk domain", while they lend us permission to have cities in their moon, which is , very nice for colonizing, they also help us on medicine and treatment of disease, showing a knowledge of such, they use fungi believe to be brought from Sùpacamác.
Ruled by a absolute monarchy, under a said "Sultan Moàmét IV/Mohammed IV" of the dynasty "Al-Mustair".
